verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a REST Workflows API that launches workflows from published templates. The platform then applies its own approval and signature policies, so an API client such as an agent can start a contract and have Ironclad route it for signature. Webhooks report events back, and signing can be embedded. However, the evidence shows no MCP server, never mentions NDAs, and does not confirm that an agent can draft the contract text itself rather than fill a pre-built template. Workflows must first be designed and published by an admin in Workflow Designer, and API access requires an add-on. Missing for 10: an MCP server, evidence that agent-driven drafting (not just template launch) works end-to-end, an NDA-specific example, a documented API step that sends for signature and tracks completion, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent draft an NDA and route it for signature end-to-end via the product's API or MCP server
